Fast workflow

  1. Load all the files. Click one in Footage.
  2. Scrub the strip under the viewer. Press I at the start of a moment, O at the end, Enter to save it. Do the whole file before grading.
  3. Click a clip, press A for Auto color, nudge sliders, then Apply to all clips if the lighting matches.
  4. Pick 9:16 and drag the picture so the speaker stays in frame. Check Safe zones.
  5. Export tab: tick the sizes, Export, then Save each file.
